name: List RFIs
description: List RFIs Retrieves a paginated list of RFIs with filtering and sorting options. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/requests/{project_type}
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/requests/{project_type}
Retrieves a paginated list of RFIs with filtering and sorting options.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID.; project_type (path) — RFI project type
Optional: page (query); pageSize (query); status (query); search (query); createdBy (query) — Filter by creator email. NOTE: For the `legal-response` project type this query parameter is **rejected with HTTP 400** — the server derives the filter from the authenticated user's JWT automatically and does not accept a client-supplied value. Requests to `legal-response` with no valid JWT identity are rejected with HTTP 401.; assignee (query); requestType (query); priority (query); tlp (query); id (query); readableId (query); summary (query); accountId (query); metadata (query) — JSON string object of metadata filters. Supports two formats: 1) Simple values for exact match (backward compatible): {"status": "open"} 2) Operator objects for advanced filtering: {"identifiers": {"operator": "contains_line", "value": "blah.com"}}. Available operators: 'eq' (exact match, default), 'contains' (substring match), 'contains_line' (match complete line in newline-separated text). Date fields are automatically normalized to YYYY-MM-DD format.; orderBy (query); order (query)

name: Create a customer follow-on message on an RFI request

context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/requests/{project_type}/{request_id}/messages/new
Creates a customer dashboard message on an RFI request. Messages are always published on send. Workflow-enabled projects require Idempotency-Key and atomically record message activity and any policy transition. For token-billed project types, substantive follow-on messages consume message tokens and are subject to quarterly quota enforcement.
Required: account_id (path); project_type (path); request_id (path)
Optional: Idempotency-Key (header) — Client command key. Required when publishing a message for a workflow-enabled project; trimmed and limited to 255 characters.; body (body)
